cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 63% of energy names green

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Refining & Downstream lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +6.75%; weakest is Refining & Downstream at -1.31%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.body: Leaders: ARRY +11.32%, BE +9.91%, TLN +9.24%, ENPH +8.06%, ETN +7.36%. Laggards: MPC -3.45%, MPLX -2.44%, FANG -1.86%, APA -1.71%.
